methodology.referenceYearPolicy: A published 2023 composite vintage is admissible only with older component baselines explicitly disclosed. It does not establish fresh 2023 hazard/exposure observation or current operational capacity.
methodology.uncertaintyPolicy: Regional SD, CV and IQR describe the 27 published values, not sampling/model uncertainty. No uncertainty interval, confidence score or precise rank claim is fabricated.

statisticalConvention.cv: 100*population SD/mean only for meaningful ratio-scale measures; null for composite indices with arbitrary zero
statisticalConvention.outliers: outside Q1-1.5IQR or Q3+1.5IQR, diagnostic only; retain source extremes
statisticalConvention.correlations: Pearson on raw observed values; Spearman uses average ranks for ties. Use complete 27-region panels with no ambiguous source interpretation; exclude supporting denominators. Constant-series correlations remain explicitly undefined, not zero. |r| >= 0.85 flags possible redundancy, never automatic removal. No population weighting.

construct.definition: Relative modeled structural disaster pressure on people, assets and regional systems after the official model accounts for vulnerability and disaster-management capacity. This is not comprehensive resilience, governance quality, a forecast or annual disaster incidence.
construct.hazard: Physical probability/intensity of a damaging event.
construct.exposure: People and assets situated in hazard zones.
construct.vulnerability: Susceptibility of exposed people/assets/systems to harm.
construct.realizedImpact: Observed harm or disruption during a stated event/reporting period.
construct.adaptiveCapacity: Ability to prepare, respond, adapt and recover. Natural direction higher is better.
construct.choice: Pressure, not inverted resilience capacity. Retain overall IRBI as the single proposed CORE; keep adaptive capacity and annual outcomes visible as non-additive context.
construct.directionPolicy: Record natural direction only. No inversion, normalization, weights or scoring in this audit.
boundaries: General pollution and air quality remain Environment.
Do not add poverty/unemployment as resilience vulnerability inputs.
Do not duplicate facilities/WASH/housing/insurance from Basic Services.
Do not move disease burden from Public Health.
